Describe the architecture you would use.why: They want to hear a coherent design and the reasons behind each choice.
Describe the architecture you would use.mistake: Listing libraries without explaining how data and events flow.
Describe the architecture you would use.followUp: What would you change for a very small app?

Walk me through what happens, layer by l.why: It shows whether your layers are real or only folder names.
Walk me through what happens, layer by l.mistake: Skipping where the write is saved and how the UI learns about it.
Walk me through what happens, layer by l.followUp: What happens if the network call fails?

Why should the database, not the network.why: It tests whether you understand offline-first design.
Why should the database, not the network.mistake: Saying only "for offline support" and missing consistency between screens.
Why should the database, not the network.followUp: How do you tell the user their change has not synced yet?

Why shouldn't the ViewModel pass the net.why: They're probing for the bugs that multiple sources of truth create.
Why shouldn't the ViewModel pass the net.mistake: Adding the database as a side cache while the UI still renders the response.
Why shouldn't the ViewModel pass the net.followUp: When is it acceptable to skip the database?

MVVM or MVI?.why: To see whether you choose patterns by trade-off rather than fashion.
MVVM or MVI?.followUp: Where would you put a one-off event in MVI?

What belongs in a ViewModel and what in.why: It checks that you put logic where it can be tested and reused.
What belongs in a ViewModel and what in.mistake: Creating a use case for every repository method.
What belongs in a ViewModel and what in.followUp: How do you test a use case?

How do you share state between two scree.why: Sharing state badly leads to stale screens and hidden coupling.
How do you share state between two scree.mistake: Passing large objects through navigation arguments or global variables.
How do you share state between two scree.followUp: When is a navigation-graph ViewModel the wrong choice?

Why keep separate models per layer?.why: To check you understand why layers need their own boundaries.
Why keep separate models per layer?.mistake: Using the network DTO as the UI model to save typing.
Why keep separate models per layer?.followUp: When is mapping between layers not worth it?

How do feature modules navigate to each.why: Large teams depend on it, so it tests your modularisation experience.
How do feature modules navigate to each.mistake: Letting one feature module depend directly on another.
How do feature modules navigate to each.followUp: How would you stop feature modules from depending on each other?

How do you introduce a new architecture.why: Senior roles require changing systems safely, not just designing new ones.
How do you introduce a new architecture.mistake: Proposing a rewrite without a pilot, measurements or buy-in.
How do you introduce a new architecture.followUp: How would you measure whether the migration is working?
